limitations: L4 establishes offline synthetic software acceptance only; never biological, physical or clinical validity.
Only fixed single-reference, unpaired two-condition, detected-value estimates and 95 percent Welch intervals; no geNorm, paired design or multiplicity adjustment.
Censored biological samples are retained and counted but omitted from detected-value estimates; n below three yields unavailable intervals and zero variance refuses.
Hashes and declarations cannot establish historical freezing or source independence. Coordinator owns rigor and independent review; review remains unavailable.

Conservative incomplete case-insensitive English whole-word prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also biomarker words, target validity, physical validity and truth; includes negations.
Every unavailable source requires unavailable claims, even with observed evidence; computed records and review approval cannot support positive claims. Replicated is refused.
Distinct inode raw inputs are bounded to 64 MiB each and 256 MiB total; hardlinks share read and parse caches and a 4000000-value conservative JSON allowance.
